advisory.headline: High landslide risk, low flood risk in Kaziranga farm area
advisory.flood_summary: Flood score 3 (Low). Peak discharge 0.24 m³/s on 2026-11-25, well below threshold 7.8 m³/s. Rain total 12.7 mm in 7 days, no surge expected.
advisory.landslide_summary: Landslide score 45 (High). Soil moisture 0.445 (peak) and 0.425 mean; relief factor 0.54. Terrain hilly upland, elevation 74 m. Rain trigger low but saturation very high.
immediate_24h_actions: Move tractors and harvest equipment to higher ground above 80 m elevation
Secure loose tools, feed bags and fertilizer sacks in sturdy sheds
Check and reinforce farmyard drainage ditches
Inspect field bunds for cracks and fill any gaps
Alert workers to avoid steep slopes and stay on marked paths
next_48_72h_actions: Create a temporary shelter on the farm for any workers displaced by landslide
Store harvested grain in airtight containers on raised platforms
Arrange for extra sandbags to protect low‑lying storage sheds
Plan alternate routes for moving produce if main road becomes blocked
agri_livestock_steps: Move livestock pens to the highest safe area, at least 5 m above current ground level
Provide extra dry bedding and feed in the elevated pens
Cover stored fodder with waterproof tarps and secure them to prevent wind lift
Check water troughs for contamination and clean them daily
evacuation_checklist: Identify nearest safe zone above 80 m elevation
Keep a ready‑to‑go bag with water, medicines, documents and flashlights
Ensure all family members know the evacuation route and meeting point
Turn off farm generators and secure fuel tanks
Notify local sarpanch of evacuation status
advisory.confidence_note: Based on telemetry and model scores, landslide risk is high while flood risk remains low. Follow actions promptly.
